MathDocs CAS modification to MathLive 0.109.0

Upstream: https://github.com/arnog/mathlive/tree/v0.109.0
Unmodified mathlive.min.js SHA-256:
8a2ff73a7b6a17c6da5086bdabd09619494e955b8da3d3e793f2496f3ee13035

The onFocus() completion callback uses a zero-delay task instead of a 60 ms
setTimeout(). This extension targets Chromium only. The callback still runs
after the current browser event, preserving MathLive's recursion guard,
native keyboard delegate, accessibility events and virtual keyboard setup.
Using a task rather than a microtask also allows native click/focus handling
to finish before MathLive focuses its keyboard delegate.
No pending 60 ms timer can subsequently steal focus from the source textarea
or the Google Docs input frame. No symbolic math code was changed.

Reproduce with: node scripts/patch-mathlive.cjs path/to/original/mathlive.min.js
The script verifies the original SHA-256 and the exact replacement.
It also verifies and reapplies an already patched file idempotently.
